title: Generate a new SSH key pair
summary: Create a new SSH key pair for secure authentication with servers or Git. You will be prompted to choose a file location and an optional passphrase.

steps.explain: Run the key generation tool. It will ask where to save the key (default is ~/.ssh/id_rsa) and if you want a passphrase.
steps.expect: The tool prompts for a file path and passphrase, then displays a randomart image and confirms the key was saved.
